name: Home Chef Production Center Bedford Park IL

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed 6901 W 65th St, Bedford Park IL 60638 (Relish Labs LLC dba Home Chef) via web search + village business registry; given coords were ~2km W on a refinery. Audited building is the tan/white spec warehouse on the E side of the N-S service road, S of W 65th St.
fieldNotes.truckGate: West face fronts a fenced truck court; chain-link sliding gate across the truck drive visible in Street View (pano jedZ3iuqhaTS5D_zsovA_A).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible at the gate in Street View or satellite; gate reads as unmanned, hence remoteGs true. Low confidence — pano coverage is from the public road, not inside the court.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Full dock bank along the W building wall with trailers backed in; ~28 doors estimated from z18/z19 satellite — band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 10-25 trailers parked along the W truck court; some appear dropped (no tractor) but resolution makes the dropped/live split uncertain.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved truck court between the gate and the dock wall provides interior holding room.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Chicago metro fabric — residential blocks directly N/W, contiguous industrial corridor; clearly Urban.
fieldNotes.buildExterior: Modern 2018-era white panel building with blue accent stripes; a leasing/'For Lease' sign on the perimeter fence suggests part of the building may be marketed, but the address and facade match the Home Chef production center.
